about: Every browser-lab result that is not PASS must match an entry here, or the run fails as UNCLASSIFIED. Kinds: 'app-finding' = a genuine application defect, which still fails the run unless the product owner records ownerAccepted: true (with name and date in ownerAcceptance); 'live-not-supported' = a fixture scenario the live UI does not offer by design, so the browser path cannot reproduce it (covered by the engine path instead). Where a result lists occurrences (overlapping text pairs, wording hits), every occurrence must match an entry's 'occurrences' pattern, and every pattern must still occur in the run: an entry or pattern that matches nothing fails the run as STALE, so a fixed defect (or a partly fixed one) must be removed from this register. Expected values are never edited to match the app. Protected by the test-integrity guard.

findings.title: Match D: a player of the team that LOST a restart (D-005 home #1, D-029 away #1)
findings.where: Live player picker: on a lost restart it offers only the winning team's squad (observed: 'player picker does not offer D Home 1 (#1); offered: D Away 1').
findings.evidence: Match D represents legacy events corrected in Review (PROVENANCE.md). The browser run tags these two events with no player (UNSUPPORTED_PLAYER=unknown) and records it; the engine path verifies the expected 'restarts lost' for both players.

findings.title: Ladies Football: a penalty two-pointer can be recorded
findings.where: Live capture: the 2PT family offers a 'Penalty' source tile; Review Edit offers TWO_POINTER for a penalty point (E-091).
findings.rule: LGFA Official Guide 2026 Rule 426 — a penalty is taken from 11 m, inside the 40 m arc: a goal (3) or a point (1), never 2.
findings.evidence: Golden Match E capture-option probe (rules/sport-rules.json captureProbes) and Review probe E-091. The fixture never records an invalid penalty two-pointer (no event substituted). Also seen by the cross-sport switching test (scripts/run-cross-sport.mjs) in every fresh and switched profile.

findings.title: Ladies Football: discipline modelled as a separate Sin Bin card instead of a first Yellow = sin bin
findings.where: Live capture and Review Edit offer a separate 'Sin Bin' discipline option; Quick Review and the Full Review Intelligence Summary count only SIN_BIN events as sin bins (expected each player's first Yellow) and only RED_CARD events as red cards (a second Yellow is a dismissal).
findings.rule: LGFA Official Guide 2026 Rule 327 — a first Yellow Card offence is the sin bin (10 min in a one-hour game); a second Yellow is a red card.
findings.evidence: Golden Match E: OPP #4 first Yellow 1H 10:00 and second Yellow 2H 20:00 (dismissal); FOR #6 Yellow, Yellow, Red; OPP #12 direct Red. Expected sin bins FOR 1 / OPP 1 (HT FOR 1 / OPP 1), red cards OPP 2. Duplicate discipline capture (a SIN_BIN alongside the Yellow) is detected by the capture-option and Review probes. Also seen by the cross-sport switching test (scripts/run-cross-sport.mjs) in every fresh and switched profile.

findings.title: Camogie: sideline scoring cannot be recorded (sideline 2-pointer, sideline point, sideline wide)
findings.where: Live capture offers no 2PT family and no 'Sideline' source tile on Point / Wide, so F-016, F-039, F-059, F-089, F-112 cannot be entered (recorded as not entered, never substituted). Reports have no 'Sideline 2PT' Quick Review row, no 'Sideline 2-pointers' Match Summary row and the Opposition Facts points label omits sideline 2-pointers. Every other UI/PDF difference that disappears when the reference is recomputed without those 5 events is DOWNSTREAM of this defect and attributed here.
findings.rule: Camogie Official Guide 2025 Part 2 Rule 15.4 (sideline puck directly over = 2 points unless touched in flight) with Rules 15.2 and 11.3 (sideline puck is a placed ball).
findings.evidence: Golden Match F: 2 successful sideline 2-pointers (FOR 1H, OPP 2H), 1 touched sideline point, 2 sideline wides. Approved report design (Phase A approval). Also seen by the cross-sport switching test (scripts/run-cross-sport.mjs) in every fresh and switched profile.
